table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	itemname= item.name,   
	aliasname=item.customicode,   
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,   
	accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
	address = dbo.customer.address1,   
	address2= dbo.customer.address2,   
	salesman = dbo.users.username,   
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,   
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
	icode = saledetail.icode,   
	batch = saledetail.batch,   
	expiry = saledetail.expiry,   
	looseqty = saledetail.looseqty,   
	bonusqty = saledetail.bonusqty,   
	packqty = saledetail.packqty,   
	packunits= saledetail.packunits,   
	saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   
	discperc = saledetail.discperc,   
	salestax = saledetail.salestax,   
	Id = dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
	itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,  
	posted=saleledger.posted,   
	balance=(select isnull(sum(v.debit - v.credit), 0) from virtualgl v
				where v.acccode=accounts.acccode group by v.acccode),   
	unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
	gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
	invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
	dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
	dbo.manufacturer.manfcode,
	manufacturer=dbo.manufacturer.name,
	custcode=dbo.accounts.acccode,
	customeraliasname=dbo.accounts.aliasname,
	dbo.saleledger.SaleCatCode,
	customer.licenceno,
	customer.licenceexpiry
FROM 
	saleledger,   
	saledetail,   
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	users,   
	item ,
	manufacturer
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.posted = 'N' ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode BETWEEN :ar_SInvCode AND :ar_LinvCode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND 
	( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode) AND 
	( dbo.item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode) 
ORDER BY
	dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode,
	dbo.manufacturer.name,
	dbo.item.name,
	dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: c_netrate
objects.expression: Round(((saleprice - itemflatdisc) * looseqty * (1- discperc * 0.01)) / if(looseqty > 0, looseqty, 1), 2)

objects.name: t_11
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)>0, 1, 0)

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all) > 0, 1, 0)
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.visible: 1	IF(Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1 ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1 )  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1 ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1 )  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: compute_14
objects.expression: if( Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1  ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0) + balance < 0, 'Cr','' )

objects.name: compute_12
objects.expression: ABS(Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1 ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1 )  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0) + balance)

objects.name: compute_11
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1 )  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for group 1) , 0)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 1)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_manfgrosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 2)

objects.name: compute_2
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 2) = 0, 0, 1)
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 2)
